line_check.method: Matched original nonempty source lines against #line coordinates, including inactive boundaries and comments. Existing mismatches listed explicitly.

transaction.scope: exact-body service doubles, not runtime/guest proof

decision: Use wow_message_finish32 for the identical nested unwind and stack-leave sequence at five sites. It captures AbnormalTermination inside the same inner finally. Keep per-caller completion timing, separate MsgFilter borrowed buffers/recursion and DDE mode restoration, TLS for independent native threads, original entry wrapped for native hook ownership, and conversion-status checks. Prior pinned whole-file review and same-source failure controls remain applicable to unchanged blocks. The related wudlg change covers only the finalizer, not its future whole-file review.
